verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents an AI-agent ecosystem (MCP servers for Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT, 'Ask/Act' agent connectivity, 'equip your agents to query, search, and act on your data') and PyAirbyte for loading into Python/AI workflows, supporting the idea that synced data becomes retrievable by agents. However, there is no explicit documentation of vector-store destinations (e.g., embeddings/Pinecone/Weaviate) or a defined 'LLM-ready format' output, so the story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit vector-store destination connectors, embedding/chunking pipeline details, and independent confirmation that synced data is directly retrievable in LLM-ready form.
